slice: S2-R2 — corrective: destruction-safe value generations + latest-wins evidence precision
authorization: Lead S2-R review at b5941c3 -> CONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE; S2-R2 GO. Fix S2-R2-F01 (pending value ops outlive destroy) and S2-R2-F02 (latest-wins evidence/wording precision) only. No engine/packaging/version/API change.

S2-R2-F01.title: Pending value applications outlive destruction
S2-R2-F01.resolution: ngOnDestroy() now also increments valueGeneration (previously only initGeneration). applySelectedValues() uses an isCurrent() predicate (!destroyed && generation === valueGeneration) for the synchronous catch, resolve, and reject paths, so a late settle (resolve or reject) after teardown cannot mutate adapter state. Defense-in-depth: the !destroyed term ignores completions even without the generation bump.
tests: ignores a LATE RESOLVE that lands after ngOnDestroy()
ignores a LATE REJECTION that lands after ngOnDestroy() (also asserts no unhandled rejection)
does not overwrite existing error state when a rejection lands after destroy()
S2-R2-F01.negativeControl: With pre-fix logic restored, 2/3 tests fail; with fix, 3/3 pass (source restored byte-identical).

S2-R2-F02.title: Latest-wins claim overstated (adapter error supersession vs end-to-end selection ordering)
S2-R2-F02.resolution: JSDoc in applySelectedValues rewritten to scope the 'latest wins' guarantee to ADAPTER error state and to state that SELECTION supersession is engine-owned (non-server synchronous replacement; server path guarded by isConnected + _asyncGeneration). Two S2-F03 test titles retitled to say 'error state wins' / 'adapter-level'; behavior unchanged.

sourceChanges: applySelectedValues(): introduced `const isCurrent = (): boolean => !this.destroyed && generation === this.valueGeneration;`; all three completion paths use isCurrent()
applySelectedValues(): JSDoc rewritten (3 adapter hazards; latest-wins scoped to adapter error state; selection supersession noted as engine-owned)
valueGeneration field comment updated (destroy bump + post-destroy settle safety)

disclosedLimitations: 44 pre-existing @smilodon/core TSC errors remain; unchanged; none reference angular.
Peer range remains >=21 <22 (narrowed at S2-R; not revisited in S2-R2).
Pre-existing failing suite npm run test:contracts (React/Solid/Vue/Svelte) unrelated to S2-R2.

No new end-to-end selection-ordering test: the adapter does not own selection supersession; asserting engine-driven selection order would exercise the engine's server-fetch path (out of authorized scope) and is documented rather than tested at the adapter level.
nonGoals: No change to previously-accepted S2 test behavior (two titles retitled only)
